onboarding.short: The guided first-run experience that gets a new customer set up.
onboarding.definition: Onboarding covers everything between signing up and getting real value: account setup, configuration, first successful use. Good onboarding shortens time-to-value and is the strongest predictor of retention.

sla.short: A contractual promise about uptime or response times.
sla.definition: A service-level agreement (SLA) defines the measurable service quality a provider commits to — e.g. 99.9% uptime or a 4-hour support response — and what happens (credits, penalties) when the commitment is missed.

churn.short: The rate at which customers stop doing business with you.
churn.definition: Churn is the percentage of customers (or revenue) lost over a period. It's the counterweight to growth: acquisition fills the bucket, churn is the hole in the bottom.
